text: The comm configuration uses @eslint/json. Its general .json block selects json/jsonc, then the package.json and .globals block selects json/json. The later strict block applies to overlapping package manifests. npm-generated package-lock.json is excluded from both ESLint and Prettier. This is the checked local file-type configuration, not a verified upstream dependency or lint-run result.
title: Comm JSON linting keeps package manifests and globals on strict JSON
